import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] p = new long[17];
    static long n;

    static long solve(long n, int len) {
        return n / p[len] * len + (n % p[len] != 0 ? Math.min(solve(n % p[len], len - 1), len + solve(p[len] - n % p[len], len - 1)) : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(n, 16));
        sc.close();
    }
}
